UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private authenticated fan profile storing personal Slendytubbies flair and status preferences.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the signed-in fan.

displayName.description: Chosen fan nickname displayed in the group.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

FanMember.title: FanMember
FanMember.description: Public non-PII fan club member card visible to other signed-in members of the group.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last profile/presence update (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatChannel.title: ChatChannel
ChatChannel.description: Topic channel in the Slendytubbies onlyfans group (e.g., general, lore, custard-hunt, sightings-2013).

sortOrder.description: Numeric ordering index for channel tabs.

createdBy.description: UID of the fan who initialized or created the channel.

lastMessageSender.description: Nickname of the fan who sent the latest message.

lastMessageAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest message (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when channel was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when channel metadata was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A glossy bubble chat message posted inside a topic channel.

senderId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the message author.

senderName.description: Denormalized fan nickname of the author.

text.description: Message body displayed inside the glossy speech bubble.

replyToId.description: Optional message ID being replied to.

replyToSender.description: Optional author name of the quoted message.

replyToText.description: Optional preview snippet of the quoted message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the message was sent (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile settings scoped strictly to the owning UID.

/fan_members/{userId}.description: Public non-PII fan directory cards for the Slendytubbies onlyfans group.

/channels/{channelId}.description: Topic channels in the Slendytubbies onlyfans group.

/channels/{channelId}/messages/{messageI.description: Real-time chat messages belonging to a topic channel.
